admin.min_posts_help: Ridge only shades threads with at least this many posts. A short thread has no shape worth drawing, and the reader can already see all of it.
admin.post_marks_label: Mark every post on the scrubber
admin.post_marks_help: Draws a thin mark for each post on the scrubber. Pointing at the scrubber opens a list of the posts around that spot, with who wrote each one and when, and clicking one jumps straight to it. On phones, tap the scrubber to open the list.
admin.big_number_help: Restyles the scrubber with a thick bar that fills as you read and the current post number shown large.
admin.years_label: Year rail on the discussion list
admin.years_help: Shows every year the list holds, newest first, each with its number of discussions and a bar shaded by how much was said that year. Clicking a year shows that year's discussions, and pointing at one previews its most active discussions. On phones it becomes a row of years above the list.
admin.years_pages_both: The discussion list and tag pages
admin.years_min_help: The rail stays hidden until the list spans at least this many years.
admin.years_date_help: When it started never changes. When it was last active moves an old discussion to this year as soon as someone replies to it.
